newsitem.title: USA: Catalyst Int'l posts Q1 loss after charge.
newsitem.headline: Catalyst Int'l posts Q1 loss after charge.

text.p: Catalyst International Inc said Friday a charge related to a reorganization program in addition to lower revenues contributed to a loss in the first quarter ended March 31.

The company reported a loss of $2.3 million, or $0.34 a share, compared to a profit of $731,000, or $0.09, in the first quarter of 1996. Revenues in the period fell to $4.1 million from $6.4 million in the same quarter last year.
The company said the charge related to the reorganization, which is expected to help the company control costs, was $187,000.
Catalyst is a warehouse management software developer whose shares closed off 1/16 Friday at 2-7/16.
